context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Plan Override feature fully tested and working. Key endpoints: POST /api/admin/users/{id}/assign-plan (assigns starter/growth), POST /api/admin/users/{id}/remove-override (reverts to free). Plan resolution priority: 1) admin_override_active=true → use admin_override_plan, 2) stripe_subscription_id exists → use stripe plan, 3) default to free. Backend helper functions get_effective_user_plan() and check_subscription_active() respect this priority. Frontend Plan Override Modal (AdminDashboard.jsx lines 820-960) shows Assign buttons for non-Stripe users and Remove Override button when override is active. Admin logs collection stores all override actions.

remove_override_endpoint.functionality: Removes admin override, reverts to free plan
